subject: Animation
title: Adult Animation Goes Mainstream
description: A micro-lesson that makes Adult Animation Goes Mainstream usable.

hook.text: For decades, animated shows for adults were oddities. The Simpsons and South Park were exceptions.

buildup.text: Then streaming arrived. Rick and Morty, BoJack Horseman, and Arcane drew massive adult audiences.

discovery.text: Studios realized adults would watch animation weekly if the stories were genuinely compelling.

twist.text: Some of the most acclaimed television of the 2020s was animated, not live action.

climax.text: Adult animation is now a permanent fixture, no longer an experiment needing permission to exist.

punchline.text: Cartoons for grownups finally earned a seat at the table.

quiz.question: What changed about adult animation in the streaming era?
options: It became less popular than ever
It moved from niche exception to mainstream format with critically acclaimed series
It was only available on one streaming platform
